name: UGC 11860, ASASSN-14dq field (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 11860, a low-luminosity galaxy that hosted the supernova ASASSN-14dq, seen by Hubble.
label: asassn14dq-hubble
story: ASASSN-14dq, a fast-declining Type II-P supernova, exploded in this faint, metal-poor galaxy. Hubble returned to the site in a snapshot survey of recent, nearby supernovae, looking for lingering light and the stars around each explosion.

claims.text: ASASSN-14dq is a fast-declining Type II-P supernova
Its host galaxy is UGC 11860, a low-luminosity, low-metallicity galaxy
Hubble observed the site in a snapshot survey of the sites of recent, nearby supernovae, aiming at late-time light and the local stellar environment
